title: MoneyWithdrawn v1
description: Domain event emitted when money is withdrawn from a wallet. Shared JSON contract between the Java Write Side and the TypeScript Read Side; not a compiled class.

eventType.description: Past-tense domain event name, independent of any internal Java class name.

eventVersion.description: Contract version, used to teach contract evolution.

eventId.description: Unique event identifier used by the Read Side for idempotent projection.

walletId.description: Free-form non-empty wallet identifier (not a UUID format).

amount.description: Withdrawn amount, strictly greater than zero.

occurredAt.description: Timestamp when the event occurred (ISO-8601 date-time).
